result.auditor_firm: Ernst & Young Audyt Polska sp. z o.o. sp.k.
result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline with Network Security v2.7

disclosed_matters.summary: ADS failed to update its Certification Policy version at least once every 365 days as required by Mozilla Root Store Policy Section 4, due to a gap in internal procedures and reliance on individual methods for handling annual updates.

During scheduled network maintenance on July 21, 2024, incorrect route configuration caused unavailability of CP/CPS, revocation request response, Certificate Problem Report, CRL, and OCSP services for approximately 1-2 hours, though no certificate issuance was affected.
